title: Pack a directory into a tar file and extract it
summary: Pack a directory tree on disk into an uncompressed tar file, then extract that file into a new directory: a project of 212 small files in 42 directories, or 13 binary files of 2.3 MB with one of exactly 1 MiB.
notes: Packages that only stream or only work asynchronously (tar-fs, tar-stream), or that only extract gzip archives (alcortesm/tgz), are not part of this task. A task on the file system: the source trees are real directories, created anew before each process, and the harness removes each archive and destination before every operation, outside what is timed; CPU time includes the kernel's part and not waiting for the disk.
